title: 第25章 墨菲定律也跟着我穿越了第26章 认真的男孩会发光
slug: 这个主角明明很强却异常谨慎
content_zh:
落仙宗，号称有十万仙门弟子。
常住人口.520左右。
落仙宗是宗门，不是学校。
所以不会免费提供给弟子任何修行资源。
所有修行资源都需要你自己去争取。
其中：
接受宗门任务。
炼制丹药贩卖。
种植灵草贩卖。
猎杀妖兽获取妖丹。
去深山老林采摘珍贵灵草……等等。
都是比较常见的获取修行资源的方法。
但有的时候。
你获取的资源并不是你所需要的。
这时候，就需要一个集市来提供交易平台。
落仙宗集市便由此而来。
集市经过几百年的职业生涯，俨然已非常成熟。
其中贩卖之物皆附和规矩。
当然，价格方便自然是随着修行资源紧缺泛滥而变化。
此刻。

集市之上，人声鼎沸。
“沃德天，快看快看，是活的李俊师兄！”
集市传来一阵喧闹。
吸引众人的目光望去。
在那人群簇拥之中。
李俊面带柔和微笑，俊秀的模样，温文尔雅的举止，超强的天赋光环。
如太阳一般，散发着身上的光辉。
从周围弟子狰狞的面部表情能够看出。
李俊在落仙宗年轻弟子中已颇具威望。
就算是师兄师姐看在有吕丹辰的面子上，也会对李俊报以微笑。
当然，以李俊的八面玲珑，很容易让这群师哥师姐喜欢上自己。
“我听说李俊师兄刚入门时仅仅炼气二阶，如今才过一年，实力竟已达到炼气三阶，一年提升一阶的实力，不愧为新生榜排名第一的天之骄子。”
“一年提升一阶算什么，我听说，李俊师兄的丹道造诣也是极高，曾叫仙鼎峰峰主亲口夸赞。”
“嗤！你们的消息也太不灵通了。”有人神秘开口：“我可是听说，李俊师兄为了磨炼自己，曾独自下山，去万墓大森林历练，你看其腰上绑的兽牙，听说是一头四阶猛虎的牙齿。”
“真的假的，妖兽天生比人族强大，李俊师兄竟越级击杀四阶妖兽，还是妖兽中的虎族，那可是拥有王类血脉的妖兽，凶残的很。”
“说的是什么，新生榜第一人的狠人，绝非浪得虚名。”
几个胸毛跟野草一样茂盛的千刃峰大汉。
磕着瓜子，喝着茶水。
如八婆一样在一处摊位前聊着八卦。
吐沫星子横飞，牛皮吹得震天响。
content_en:
The Luo Xian Sect claims to have one hundred thousand Immortal Sect disciples.
The permanent population is about 520.
Luoxian Sect is a sect, not a school.
Therefore, no cultivation resources will be provided to disciples for free.
All cultivation resources need to be obtained by yourself.
Among them:
Accept the sect mission.
Refining elixirs and selling them.
Grow spiritual herbs and sell them.
Hunt monsters to get monster pills.
Go to the deep mountains and old forests to pick precious spiritual herbs...and so on.
They are all relatively common ways to obtain practice resources.
But sometimes.
The resources you acquire are not what you need.
At this time, a market is needed to provide a trading platform.
This is where the Luoxianzong Market comes from.
After hundreds of years of business, the market has become very mature.
Everything sold follows the rules.
Of course, the price and convenience will naturally change with the shortage of cultivation resources.
now.
The market was buzzing with people.
"Wardian, look, look, it's Senior Brother Li Jun alive!"
There was a commotion from the market.
Attracting everyone's attention.
Among the crowd.
Li Jun has a soft smile on his face, handsome appearance, gentle manner, and a strong aura of talent.
Like the sun, it exudes the brilliance of its body.
It can be seen from the ferocious facial expressions of the surrounding disciples.
Li Jun is already quite prestigious among the young disciples of Luo Xian Sect.
Even the senior brothers and sisters would smile at Li Jun for Lu Danchen's sake.
Of course, with Li Jun's all-round intelligence, it would be easy for these senior brothers and sisters to fall in love with him.
"I heard that Senior Brother Li Jun was only at the second level of Qi Refining when he first started. Now, only one year has passed, and his strength has reached the third level of Qi Refining. With his strength improving by one level every year, he is worthy of being ranked first on the freshman list."
"It's nothing to be promoted by one level in one year. I heard that Senior Brother Li Jun's attainments in alchemy are also very high. He once had the Master of Xianding Peak praise him personally."
"Hi! Your information is too ill-informed." Someone said mysteriously: "I heard that in order to hone himself, Senior Brother Li Jun once went down the mountain alone to the Ten Thousand Tombs Forest to practice. Look at the animal teeth tied around his waist. I heard they were the teeth of a fourth-level tiger."
"Really or not, monsters are naturally stronger than humans. Senior Brother Li Jun actually jumped over the level and killed a fourth-level monster. He was also a tiger among monsters. That monster has the blood of a king, and it is very ferocious."
"What are you talking about? The ruthless person who is number one on the freshman list is definitely not in vain."
Several Thousand Blades Peak men with chest hair as thick as weeds.
Crack melon seeds and drink tea.
Chatting and gossiping in front of a stall like the eighth wife.
The spitting stars are flying everywhere, and the cowhide is blowing loudly.
